section: Periodic Transaction Report - attached transaction table

uncertainties.note: Dense sideways scan; transaction rows were extracted from rotated page image and OCR coordinates.
uncertainties.read: Apple Vision OCR plus coordinate-based checkbox extraction

uncertainties.note: Original extraction mis-mapped the 'Type of Transaction' checkbox column for these 12 CALL/... FLEX EURO option rows: 8 of 12 (SMFG, RIO, EWJ, NVS, TAK, EWA, TTE, HSBC) had tx_type read as 'Sale' when the scan's checkbox grid clearly shows an 'x' in the 'Purchase' column for all 12 rows in this block (verified by pixel-aligned column-boundary overlay against the header row). Corrected all 12 to tx_type='Purchase'. Also corrected notification_date from 02/13/2026 (a copy of the Date of Transaction column) to 03/04/2026, which is what the scan's 'Date Notified' column actually shows for every row in this block.
uncertainties.read: Re-transcribed directly from rendered scan (docs/2026-2/pages/page-031.jpg via render.py, --bands=3)

uncertainties.note: Original rows 13-15 (0-indexed) concatenated fragments from what are actually 5 distinct scan rows: one CALL/CCEP FLEX EURO option row plus four separate PUT/XSP option rows (strikes 645 EXP 05/15/2026, 647 EXP 04/30/2026, 640 EXP 04/24/2026, and 645 EXP 04/10/2026), each with its own Date of Transaction and correct amounts. Re-split into 5 correctly separated tx rows (now array indices 13-17) in scan order, each with owner SP, tx_type: CALL/CCEP='Purchase' (matching the other 11 CALL rows in this block) and all 4 PUT/XSP rows='Sale' (checkbox grid confirms 'x' under Sale for all four), notification_date=03/04/2026 for all five, and amount='$1,001-$15,000' for all five, matching the surrounding rows. Unlike the abbreviated asset_name style used for the CALL rows at indices 2-13 (which cut off at 'EXP' without the expiration date), these 5 new rows include the full EXP date in asset_name, since two of the PUT/XSP rows share the same $645 strike and would otherwise be indistinguishable by asset_name alone.
